title: Implied authority
text:
19.30.020 Implied authority.
Authority. City officials and decision-makers shall have all implied authority necessary to carry out the duties and responsibilities expressly delegated by this title to the extent the implied authority is not in conflict with the expressly delegated authority.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
(Ord. No. 17236, § 27, 11-10-2009)
